title: Concept: Regular expression built from a non-literal (javascript)
description: A RegExp built from input inherits the input complexity. Backtracking on crafted patterns is a denial-of-service route. The remedy is a literal regex or a vetted pattern table.
applicability: JavaScript and TypeScript code building regular expressions at runtime; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Event-loop blocking from catastrophic backtracking; MEDIUM severity.
